...Well, if that's cool with you, I mean.

Contrary to her casual tone, the look in Toosen Jordan's eyes
was utterly serious. There was not a single reason to refuse.
...Pfft.

A dead heat! Is it Gold Ship?! Or is it
Toosen Jordan?! Coming out on top in this fierce battle is—

...Aaah...
...Heheheh, yeah, this totally feels great.

The race is already heading into the final turn! Toosen Jordan
has secured a great position! Can she maintain the lead—

Geesh, I said I heard you! How many times are you gonna say it?
Seriously, even mid-race, for real...

So... what if... What if I end up losing? What do I do?
Aha. Maybe, y'know, this time I'll never run again for the rest of—

Oh, Toosen Jordan's running. Is she back?
Come to think of it, she's been working pretty hard in training lately.
Haa, haa... Haaah—!

Wanna dig a hole to Brazil with me?! Huh?!?
I'll let you feel the searing heat of the Earth's mantle! Firsthand!

Hey, so like, my training with you ends today, right?
So, uh... Do you... have an Umamusume to train?

Heh.
...Well then, guess it's settled! Looking forward to working with you☆

Aren't you, like, believing in me way too much?
That's honestly hilarious!

...—Ngh, yeah, I can do this!
If I gas out here, there's no way I'm gonna win...!
Haaaaaaaahhh!!
There you are, there you are, there you aaaaare!!
Out of the way, out of the way, out of my waaaay!!

—Dammit...!!
Let's do thiiiiiis~~!!

—And here comes Gold Ship! What an incredible surge!
She's steadily widening the gap against Toosen Jordan!
...Huh?
Just then—

Yeah. The other day, it seemed like she lost heart halfway and gave up.
I just hope she can finish the race today...

After that, I spent day after day dedicating myself to training
alongside Toosen Jordan for the upcoming meet.

If you don't have one, I could always step up, y'know?
I mean, if you just wander around without anyone to train, you might get fired, right?

Wait, huh? What? What is up with this girl?
I literally don't get her at all!!

(......Ngh.
What the heck, you always say the exact same thing!)

(—Stay calm, stay calm, just like in training!
...Heh, looking good! —I've got this!)

Her final counterattack sparked immense excitement,
and the 2000m turf race drew to a close amidst thunderous applause.

"Your desire to win is your greatest weapon."
—"You will definitely win. I give you my word."
(What if this time... I never wanna run again for the rest of my life?)

"Your desire to win is your greatest weapon."
—"You will definitely win. I guarantee it."
Toosen Jordan!!
Ha, ha, haa, haaah~~~.

Wait, oh! Toosen Jordan?! Toosen Jordan
is closing in on Gold Ship with incredible momentum!

Hey, I've been looking for you, blue girl! Like, seriously—
aren't you just bursting with crazy, super-duper fired-up hype right now?!

Amidst a whirlwind of soaring emotions—
the 2000m turf race of the meet got underway!
*pant*, *gasp*! Haa... haa...!

Hey. Sounds kinda weird to say, but... I, like...
...Right now, I think I want to win more than I ever have before.

Aah, I'm so beat. Today I'm totally gonna do a face pack,
an oil massage, light some scented candles, and crash!
(—...What if. What if I lose?)

The gap is insane. Between me and the others in my class. Like, haven't
I lost enough for a whole lifetime? It's just loss after loss after loss.

From that day on, Toosen Jordan's days of being chased down
by Gold Ship began... but that is a story for another time.
And finally, the day of the race arrived.

And then... the day before the meet.
As I turned to head home, Toosen Jordan grabbed my arm.
